title: SearXNG (web search)
description: A SearXNG instance, yours or one you may use, as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: The instance must answer JSON: in its settings.yml, search: formats must list json. The connector takes no key. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then put it to use by choosing it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service: <name>. An instance behind a proxy that wants a key: add a bearer credential for its address under API Credentials and name it in the spec's auth in place of none.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: Instance address
questions.help: Where the instance is, with the path it is under if it has one: https://searx.example.com, or http://localhost:8888 for one on this machine.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; Web Search lists it by this name.
